description: This file contains implementation of statistical data collection, management, and reporting functions for the qhull computational geometry library, including functions for initializing, collecting, printing, and freeing statistics, as well as internal data structures and macros.

methods.name: qh_allstatA
methods.description: Defines a group of statistics related to precision and output features.

methods.name: qh_allstatB
methods.description: Defines statistics related to output facets, ridges, and vertices.

methods.name: qh_allstatC
methods.description: Defines statistics related to hull building process, including visible facets and angles.

methods.name: qh_allstatD
methods.description: Defines partitioning and inside point statistics.

methods.name: qh_allstatE
methods.description: Defines statistics for inside points, coplanar points, and related tests.

methods.name: qh_allstatE2
methods.description: Defines statistics for ridge matching and merge determination.

methods.name: qh_allstatF
methods.description: Defines statistics for merging processes.

methods.name: qh_allstatG
methods.description: Defines statistics for coplanar and concave facet merges.

methods.name: qh_allstatH
methods.description: Defines statistics for vertex merging and related operations.

methods.name: qh_allstatI
methods.description: Defines statistics for Voronoi ridge calculations.

methods.name: qh_allstatI
methods.description: Defines statistics for triangulation ('Qt') process.

methods.name: qh_allstatistics
methods.description: Resets the printed flag for all statistics.

methods.name: qh_collectstatistics
methods.description: Collects various statistics from the current qhull run, including facets, ridges, vertices, and angles.

methods.name: qh_freestatistics
methods.description: Frees memory used for storing statistics.

methods.name: qh_initstatistics
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the statistics data structures.

methods.name: qh_newstats
methods.description: Checks if there are new statistics to print for a given index.

methods.name: qh_nostatistic
methods.description: Determines if a statistic is at its initial value and thus not to be printed.

methods.name: qh_printallstatistics
methods.description: Prints all collected statistics with a header string.

methods.name: qh_printstatistics
methods.description: Prints statistics for a group, skipping those already printed.

methods.name: qh_printstatlevel
methods.description: Prints detailed information for a specific statistic.

methods.name: qh_printstats
methods.description: Prints statistics for a group of statistics identified by a starting index.

methods.name: qh_stddev
methods.description: Calculates the standard deviation and average from statistical sums.
